            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3747">bcom ldan 'das byams pa</rs>s bde bar gshegs pa'i bka'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par gsal <choice><reg>bar</reg><orig>‹ba›r</orig></choice> mdzad pa na | nges pa'i don gi mdo sde rin po che | phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo | chos kyi dbyings tshul cig du <lb edRef="inst:4440" n="1b2"/> ston pa | shin tu rnam par dag pa gdon myi za ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs khams thabs cad kyi don rab du ×ston pa | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3749">theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan chos</rs> 'di mdzad pas | theg pa chen po'i don gi de kho na rnam par bzhag pa yin no || </seg></TEI>
